summary: Pod boutique/gateway-6d5b6dd4f9-kxn5z container gateway was terminated due to OOMKilled
root_cause: The container gateway in the pod gateway-6d5b6dd4f9-kxn5z was killed by the host OOM killer because it exceeded its memory limit of 256Mi.
supporting_evidence: The pod was running on node i-0ed85ce505ebc5d28.
The memory usage of the container gateway in the pod gateway-6d5b6dd4f9-kxn5z was 24903680.0 bytes (approximately 23.7Mi), which is below the limit but close to it.
The node did not report MemoryPressure, indicating that the OOM killer was triggered by the container exceeding its memory limit.
recommended_actions: Investigate the memory usage patterns of the gateway container to identify potential memory leaks or spikes.
Consider increasing the memory limit for the gateway container if the current limit is consistently being approached.
risks: Potential service disruption if the gateway pod is unable to recover or if the memory issue persists.
Repeated OOMKilled events may lead to degraded performance or instability in the application.
